title: South Harpeth River Retreat
description:
This is a  70 acre retreat center in Nashville, with over 1 mile of South Harpeth River. We are the furthest west of Nahville , placing us in the rolling Hills shared between Fairview,Franklin and Leipers Fork. This river is pristine and clear. This farm/retreat center has been her for almost 80 years now. It is a secret to the area and we hope to keep it that way. It is barely booked, so that our guests can feel like they have the whole place to themselves. You have full river and farm access.

The space
This property is 70 acres with about 30 acres of crops growing, 20 acres of green grass surrounding a gazebo , pole barn, and various out door meeting settings with several fire pits at different locations . There is over 1 mile of pristine river frontage that is excellent for swimming , kayaking , tubing , fishing or good sun tanning on the beach-like sand and rock. The bunkhouse lodge sleeps 32 people and when you would like more than the top floor (3 bedrooms and sleeps 12) make mention and we will open the first floor (8 bedrooms and 5 bathrooms) for an additional $400 plus $100 cleaning fee. There is also a meeting room that is a kitchen with a large open room good for up to 50 people. I you need a sanctuary for larger groups (holds 150-200 people) make mention and we can add that to your rental for $400 a day plus $200 cleaning fee. SEE PHOTOS  for add on spaces

Guest access
If you are renting the top floor of the bunkhouse, the access is on the side with a metal staircase.This rental includes everything that can be access on the second level. When renting both floors ( make mention in a message)you get the entire building that sleeps up to 32 people. 
The code for the white gate to farm is             0217
The code for key lock box top floor is             2222
 
Wether you are renting the top or both floors of the bunkhouse, you have access to gazebo, pole barn and can wander around the gorgeous property with several different river access points.If you want to tube or kayak, there are walking trails along the river that will take you back into the woods , down stream to the bridge on hwy 100. Some people like to float this and it can take 30-45 minutes. Please do not enter property on the other side of this river .You can wander upstream until you see a brown log cabin with a green metal roof. Do not go upstream past this property. The neighbors are very protective of their property lines , they are aware this is retreat center with many different guests and have made it clear for us to stay on our property. Please respect this.
You can park any where on the property but please be careful if it has been raining so you do not get stuck in soggy grass.

During your stay
There  are 3 camper/rv sites next to the bathhouse.  When there are renters at these sites , they will be aware that you have right of way to use of pole barn and gazebo if you are having a gathering of some sort. There are several neighboring dogs that are friendly, if you are bringing a pet please make sure they are on a leash .
